claim_ceiling: Synthetic analytic mechanics only; no real factor headroom, learned performance, active-view utility, device, product or safety evidence.

identifiability_rule.measurement_matrix: Whitened measurement-residual Jacobian only; exclude priors, damping, LM terms and regularizers.
identifiability_rule.measurement_interval_rule: Project the frozen 95% whitened residual-noise ball through the strong-subspace pseudoinverse and query Jacobian. Report this half-width separately; it may widen the decision interval but may never add or remove measurement rank.
identifiability_rule.update_rule: Update only the strong right-singular subspace. Freeze every weak component; never turn a weak component into strong using a prior or regularizer.
identifiability_rule.limiting_null_rule: Null(F) subset Null(J_C) is reported as the zero-noise limiting diagnostic, not used alone as the finite gate.
